name: reel-story
title: reel-story
description: From Jenesyx/arta-edit-studio: turns Farsi-first talking-head videos into animated Instagram Reels — this representative skill is the full-screen story format with B-roll and stickers, rendered with HyperFrames from a Whisper transcript, with no burned-in subtitles. The repo also ships the reel-setup and reel-split skills.
why: A Farsi-first Reels editing workflow, unique in the collection and close to the curator's own content work; link-only while the young repo matures.
